  • **Persistence:** No evidence of systemd units, cron jobs, launch agents, shell profile edits, background polling loops, or self-reinstallation.
  • **Lateral movement:** Terms such as use_irsa appear to be normal S3 ingest options. No evidence of Kubernetes service-account token theft, Docker socket access, cloud metadata abuse, or CI/GitHub Actions token misuse was found.
  • **Obfuscation / loader:** Uses of cryptography.fernet, base64, and ast.literal_eval appear in normal configuration encryption or data parsing contexts. No evidence of eval/exec/compile loaders, marshal/pickle payloads, obfuscated downloader stubs, platform-specific RAT selection, or self-deleting droppers was found.
  • **Network:** Observed URLs point to H2O.ai/H2OGPTE official services, documentation, GitHub, or example domains. No raw IP endpoints, paste/drop services, or plausible attacker C2 endpoints were identified.
